rule.description: A function or method (constructors exempt) whose formal parameters pass three or more members of one device's identity (did, dtype, type, model, mac, mac2, ieee, nwk, fw_ver, hw_ver, cloud_did) as separate values instead of one identity object; constructors are exempt because a container class names its own parts at its single definition point.

checks.description: Detect functions and methods that receive or forward device identity as a group of separate formal parameters.
checks.detected_relation: function formal parameters -> members of the identity of one child device registered through the gateway adapter layer
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The detected fields describe one thing (which physical device has been discovered), are produced together by each transport, and are consumed together by device registration; threading them as parallel parameters through the adapters is the data-clump shape, and the exemption-free definition also covers the registration factory and the delayed unknown-device task.

matches.evidence: def init_device(self, model, did, dtype, mac=None, ieee=None, nwk=None, **kwargs): with did, dtype, ieee, mac, model, nwk all passed as separate parameters; this is the shared factory every transport funnels into.
async def base_read_device(self, did, model, mac, fw_ver, mac2=None): replaces the previous info dict; the gateway self-registration identity arrives as five separate values.

def zigbee_identity(did, model, mac, nwk, app_ver, hard_ver, xiaomi_did=None): duplicates the raw row under four identity names and returns them as a bare positional tuple that lumi_read_devices destructures.
def ble_identity(did, model, mac): returns did, model, mac.lower() as a bare tuple; consumed by the DB-table path (byte-reversed mac) and by the on-the-fly report path.
def mesh_identity(did, model, mac): returns did, model, mac.lower() as a bare tuple that the mesh bulb discovery loop destructures before registering.
async def silabs_process_unknown(self, uid, did, ieee, nwk): the unknown zigbee device's identity crosses the 10-second delayed task boundary as three separate scalar arguments.

excluded.reason: already receives the device identity as one collected mapping via **kwargs; it names the fields at the single definition point, which is the container shape the smell wants, not a threaded group.
two identity members plus one key-derivation secret; a small pure helper, not a group threaded across interfaces.
gateway connection data (host, token, key): a different relation with a different lifetime than device identity.
lifecycle propagation of already-built devices (payload, gateway, timestamp), not identity hand-off.
receives the whole XDevice object, the already-encapsulated form.
